title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 20:00 UTC on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日 20:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 0.33 (label 0P). Last-180-sample maximum is 0.67 (20:49 UTC; last-180 window begins about 17:56 UTC); published-window maximum is 1.00 (14:58 UTC). Hours through 13:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window; 14:00 UTC is partial (2 samples from 14:58). Completed bins 15:00–19:00 UTC closed at 0.33 / 0.33 / 0.33 / 0.33 / 0.33 respectively (15:00 peak 0.33 / 0P at 15:40, closed at 0.33 / 0P, 60 samples; 16:00 peak 0.33 / 0P at 16:00, closed at 0.33 / 0P, 60 samples; 17:00 peak 0.33 / 0P at 17:00, closed at 0.33 / 0P, 60 samples; 18:00 peak 0.33 / 0P at 18:39, closed at 0.33 / 0P, 60 samples; 19:00 peak 0.33 / 0P at 19:00, closed at 0.33 / 0P, 60 samples). 20:00 UTC bin is in progress (56 samples; hour-start 0.33 / 0P at 20:00; in-hour peak 0.67 / 1M at 20:49; latest raw sample 0.00 / 0Z at 20:55 treated as a new-minute placeholder and not used as the card value). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute (20:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off.
